key_insight: RheOPT transfers geometry-conditioned transport structure from Newtonian simulations to improve non-Newtonian flow prediction with few target samples.
engineering_relevance: Pretraining on inexpensive Newtonian simulations can reduce the costly non-Newtonian training data needed for neural-operator surrogates.
method: Pretrain a transformer-based neural operator on Newtonian flow simulations.
Fine-tune on a few non-Newtonian samples in matched geometries.
Evaluate field prediction and phase-insensitive wake dynamics.
evidence_signal: Across contraction and triangular-obstacle wake tests, four-sample fine-tuning can match or exceed 16-sample training from scratch in the contraction, while wake diagnostics show recovered shedding frequency and fluctuation amplitude.
watch_item: Transfer gains depend on normalization: they are reliable with RevIN but dataset dependent with Global normalization; geometry-mismatched transfer is not established.
paper_title: RheOPT: Few-Shot Non-Newtonian Flow Prediction via Newtonian Pretraining of RheOFormer
